relationships.subject: CGRP-targeted therapies
relationships.evidence_quote: CGRP-targeted therapies were not associated with a statistically significant increase in hypertension risk in patients with migraine

relationships.subject: galcanezumab
relationships.evidence_quote: galcanezumab also showed no statistically significant association (RR 1.14, 95% CI 0.54-2.39)

key_findings: Meta-analysis of 19 RCTs: pooled RR for hypertension with CGRP-targeted therapies 0.91 (0.58-1.43), no significant increased risk.
Certainty of evidence very low; erenumab RR 0.71, galcanezumab RR 1.14, both non-significant.
